Generate two files for an SEO audit report — an XLSX and a DOCX — based on the findings below. Save both to /Users/a39326/Downloads/

**Filenames:**
- XLSX: `seo-audit-cars24-jaguar-2026-03-19-19-30.xlsx`
- DOCX: `seo-audit-cars24-jaguar-2026-03-19-19-30.docx`

---

## AUDIT DATA

**Crawl:** Claude Test | cars24.com/new-cars/jaguar/ | 379 URLs | 70.84% complete | 19-Mar-2026

---

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

- **Site:** https://www.cars24.com/new-cars/jaguar/
- **Crawl date:** 19 March 2026
- **URLs discovered:** 379 (crawl 70.84% complete)
- **Indexable pages:** ~195
- **Non-indexable pages (noindex):** ~55 (all I-Pace city price pages)
- **Overall Health Score:** 61% (92 checks passed, 58 warnings/fails out of 150)
- **Technology:** Next.js + Cloudflare CDN, HTTP/2

**Top 10 Critical Issues:**
1. 50+ I-Pace city price pages marked `noindex` — these pages receive internal links, wasting crawl budget
2. loans24.co.in (external blocked URL) receives 281 internal links — massive link equity waste
3. Title tags say "Old Jaguar XF/F-Type specifications" — signals stale content to Google
4. Missing H1 on all 4 video index pages (i-pace/videos, xf/videos, f-type/videos, f-pace/videos)
5. No VideoObject schema on video pages — missing video rich result eligibility
6. XF city price pages: 39–65 Rich Result Errors per page — product schema broken
7. Review page has no AggregateRating/Review schema — missed rich snippet opportunity
8. Title tags under 30 chars on video pages (e.g. "Jaguar XF Videos" = 16 chars)
9. Title tags over 60 chars on F-Pace and I-Pace price pages (73–80 chars = truncated in SERP)
10. Meta descriptions over 160 chars on variant pages (up to 228 chars)

## PRIORITY ACTION PLAN

### 🔴 CRITICAL — Fix Immediately
1. **Remove "Old" from XF and F-Type specifications titles** — currently `Old Jaguar XF specifications, features and configurations` and `Old Jaguar F-Type specifications, features and configurations` — this actively signals stale content to Google and users
2. **Fix loans24.co.in internal link (281 inlinks)** — an external URL blocked by robots.txt is receiving the most internal links in the crawl. Remove or change this URL sitewide. This is leaking link equity to a non-indexable external page.
3. **Add VideoObject schema to all video pages** — 4 video index pages and multiple individual video detail pages have zero schema markup. VideoObject enables rich video snippets in Google Search.
4. **Fix XF city price page schema errors** — 39–65 Rich Result Errors per page (vs 10 for F-Pace pages). Review Product/Offer/PriceSpecification implementation specifically for Jaguar XF pages.

### 🟠 HIGH — Fix This Sprint
5. **Add H1 to video index pages** — `/jaguar/i-pace/videos/`, `/jaguar/xf/videos/`, `/jaguar/f-type/videos/`, `/jaguar/f-pace/videos/` all have empty H1. Add descriptive H1 like "Jaguar F-Pace Video Reviews & Walkarounds"
6. **Fix title tags under 30 chars on video pages** — "Jaguar XF Videos" (16 chars) is below threshold. Update to include keywords e.g. "Jaguar XF Videos: Reviews, Walkarounds & Test Drives"
7. **Trim title tags over 60 chars on F-Pace and I-Pace price pages** — approximately 80+ pages affected. F-Pace: truncate to ~58 chars. Note: I-Pace pages are noindex so less urgent.
8. **Trim variant page meta descriptions** — `/jaguar/i-pace/variants/` and `/jaguar/f-type/variants/` have 228-char descriptions. Truncate to 155 chars.
9. **Add Organization schema** — no Organization schema found on any page. Add to homepage/hub pages.
10. **Add AggregateRating/Review schema to review page** — `/jaguar/xf/review/` only has BreadcrumbList. Add AggregateRating schema with 13 reviews noted on page.

### 🟡 MEDIUM — Fix This Month
11. **Validate I-Pace noindex strategy** — ~55 I-Pace city price pages are noindex but receive significant internal links. Either: (a) remove these pages, (b) remove internal links to them, or (c) unblock if the car is available for order
12. **Fix duplicate video page titles and meta descriptions** — multiple video sub-pages share "Jaguar XF Videos" and "Explore a captivating video gallery..." — add unique titles/descriptions per video
13. **Add LocalBusiness/AutoDealer schema to hub pages** — no dealer/business schema found sitewide
14. **Differentiate E-Pace city price page content** — currently these pages say "Jaguar E-Pace expected price in [City]" suggesting no actual price data. Add real pricing or noindex until available.
15. **Add meaningful H1 to XF review page** — current H1 "On-Road score" is not descriptive. Use "Jaguar XF User Reviews & Ratings"
16. **Add I-Pace/F-Type sitemap.xml review** — I-Pace is noindexed but has its own sitemap; F-Type pages include "Old" in their titles. Review both content strategies.

### 🟢 LOW — Backlog
17. **Improve internal linking depth** — some I-Pace city pages reach crawl depth 7–8. Add hub-level internal links to reduce click depth.
18. **Differentiate XF city price page meta descriptions** — currently all follow template "Jaguar XF price in [City] - get Ex-showroom and on-road old price..." — the word "old" is present in XF descriptions too.
19. **Audit product image alt text** — SF did not capture product images in this crawl. Run a targeted audit on car image alt attributes.
20. **Audit third-party scripts** — Cloudflare Insights confirmed; ensure no duplicate analytics tags.
